quote: Waer Waters hotel**** - Waer Waters

claim: Waer Waters is 4-star, adults-only (21+), with six pools and 12,000 m² wellness garden, 27 rooms with heated floors and Smart TVs.

claim: Villa Servais is a restored 19th-century neo-Palladian villa at Servaislaan 8, Halle, with 8 luxurious B&B rooms, 200m from Halle station; named after cellist François Servais.
quote: Villa Servais is situated at Servaislaan 8, 1500 Halle, Belgium, positioned conveniently 200 meters from the railway station and bus stop. ... restored 19th-century villa constructed in neo-Palladian architectural style ... eight luxurious rooms

claim: Villa Servais was designed in 1847 by Jean-Pierre Cluysenaar for cellist Adrien François Servais; bas-reliefs on the façade by Cyprien Godebski (1864).
quote: Architect Jean-Pierre Cluysenaar designed the imposing villa in 1847 for cellist Adrien François Servais ... The Franco-Polish sculptor Cyprien Godebski carved the famous bas-reliefs on the façade in 1864.

claim: Villa Servais was acquired in 2016 by Maud and Geert de Poorter and renovated room by room after standing empty since 1981; now operates as eight-room guesthouse.
quote: In 2016, new owners Maud, Geert, and their daughter Enora acquired the villa and completely renovated it, which had been empty since 1981.

claim: B&B St-Hubert is at Rosweg 68B, 1750 Lennik (Sint-Martens-Lennik), on a working manège with Friesian horses; 5 rooms named after the horses; from €110/night; outdoor pool and hot tub.
quote: 5 comfortable romantic-style rooms named after their horses: Mien, Jack, Roos, Julius and Zafiera ... outdoor swimming pool, a hot tub ... starting price is €110.00 per room

claim: T'Rest is a B&B, restaurant and event venue inside the neoclassical Kasteel Ter Rijst in Heikruis (Park ter Rijst, Pepingen).

claim: Curated Pajottenland lodging round-up cites T'Rest as the Blind Getrouwd TV-show castle venue; Villa Servais as a 19th-century cellist's villa; Het Verblijf as a Brabant farmhouse; St-Hubert as an equestrian estate; De Woestijn as a renovated farmhouse with pool.
quote: B&B T'Rest - Park ter Rijst (Heikruis) — Featured on Blind Getrouwd TV show, castle views, on-site restaurant ... Villa Servais (Halle) — 19th-century neoclassical villa of cellist François Servais

claim: B&B Het Verblijf is a restored authentic Brabant three-sided farmhouse 200+ years old, walking distance to Gaasbeek; Rosweg 54, 1750 Lennik.
